desc: Derive the root-to-node sliding-window invariant: a duplicate previously at depth `p` forces valid-window start to `max(left, p + 1)`.
Choose iterative enter/exit DFS events to avoid recursion-depth failure and restore branch-local occurrence state.
Implement adjacency construction and the iterative DFS solution in the provided Python starter code.
Validate zero-length, duplicate-value, weighted-length, sibling rollback, and equal-length node-count tie cases.
